thread:
Alex: Drafting the release notes for tomorrow's rollout (service v2.4.1). Planning a short internal blast and an ops pin. Can we lock the deploy window now?
Maya: 👍 share the RN bullets here and I'll quick-edit.
Alex: Quick bullets below — please flag anything missing: 
```
- Feature: adaptive batching enabled for low-latency paths
- Fix: KV cache flush bug for long-running sessions
- Ops: new canary policies + automatic fallback to v2.3-stable
- Note: embeddings model pinned to rwd-embed-3 for EU region
```
Priya: Heads up — I'm oncall from 15:30-17:00 PT tomorrow. Can we avoid a 16:00 PT cutover?
Tim: If we move later, we need staging smoke at least 30m before cutover (1630 -> 1700 => smoke at 1630 -> 1630 is OK).
Jordan: I'll own rollback. Rollback criteria I'd use: >1% error spike across 5m, or p99 latency >800ms for 3m, or customer-facing 5xxs in >3% of requests.
Alex: Good. Can we pin the release note to internal channel after Tim's smoke? Also need an ops pin (who wants to claim?).
Maya: I'll take ops pin and standby cadence. I'll post the pinned message after smoke and tag @Oncall.
Alex: Sending deploybot schedule command now — requesting canary -> gradual over 15m, fallback to v2.3-stable.
DeployBot: /schedule deploy service:v2.4.1 env:prod start:2026-03-24T17:00:00-07:00 rollout:canary(10%:5m)->gradual(15m) fallback:service:v2.3-stable
DeployBot: Scheduled by Alex. Canary start: 2026-03-24 17:00 PT. Rollout timeline posted in #eng-releases. Link: https://deploy.example.org/s/12345
Priya: Thanks — I can be on standby until 18:30 PT then.
Tim: I'll run the staging smoke at 16:30 PT and post results here.
Maya: I'll draft the internal announcement now, short bullet RN + rollback lanes + who to ping. Preview: 
```
Internal RN (v2.4.1) — deploy 17:00 PT tomorrow
- Quick bullets (features/fixes/ops)
- Canary -> gradual 15m, automatic fallback to v2.3-stable
- Rollback criteria & who to ping: Jordan (rollback), Maya (ops pin), Priya (oncall)
- Staging smoke at 16:30 PT; hold if smoke fails
```
Jordan: Confirmed, I'll be ready to execute rollback. Keep the deploybot link handy.
Alex: Perfect. Once Tim posts smoke OK, Maya please pin and I'll do the internal blast copy. :thumbsup:
Maya: On it. I'll post pinned message and tag @Oncall after smoke passes.
Tim: staging smoke done @Alex — all green (small latency bump within expected). Posting logs: https://ci.example.org/builds/9876/logs
Maya: Pinning RN now and posting internal announcement.
Alex: Thanks team. We'll monitor metrics for the first 30m and use Jordan's rollback criteria if anything crosses thresholds.
Oncall: Acknowledged — will escalate if needed. :wave:
